title: Titanium Bleed Air Duct
function: Engine bleed air duct (Grade 9 Ti tube)
alloyReason: Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V (UNS R56320) is specified for this pneumatic system application needing intermediate strength between CP and Ti-6Al-4V with superior cold formability. Its 620 MPa tensile with 20% elongation provides 30% weight reduction vs steel. This rationale is driven by engine bleed air duct (grade 9 ti tube) and fat life requirements.
process: 5-axis CNC roughing for pneumatic system geometry
Wire EDM contour profiling with Class 6g gauge
CMM per AS9102 with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Shot peening Almen 0.008-0.012A inducing compressive residual stress for extended HCF life in aerospace service — tailored for engine bleed air application
commonFailures: Fretting fatigue at dovetail interface - mitigated by shot peen Almen 0.008A + dry-film lubricant coating — critical for engine bleed air performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Bleed Air Duct suitable for Engine bleed air duct (Grade 9 Ti tube)?
faq.a: Titanium Bleed Air Duct uses Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pneumatic system operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Bleed Air Duct?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Bleed Air Duct is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for engine bleed air requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Bleed Air Duct require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. engine bleed air components require Shot peening Almen 0.008-0.012A inducing compressive residual stress for extended HCF life in aerospace service — tailored for engine bleed air application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Bleed Air Duct shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Bleed Air Duct includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet engine bleed air specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Bleed duct / Bleed air line pneumatic system components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
